content:
Jules: Dropping an alternate take on the alerting SLO editor — focused on density presets + clearer suppression UX. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/alerts-redesign. Main goals: make thresholds scannable in compact lists, provide an explicit "Preview send" area, and make suppression quick-grammar friendly. Feedback welcome. :wave: Arjun: Clean direction. A couple of practical constraints: touch targets shouldn't go below 20px height. If we compress rows, move toggles to the right rail and increase hit area there. Also prefer an overflow chip that says "+2 channels" with a tooltip rather than ellipses. Nora: A11y: the preview region needs an accessible label and live updates. Use aria-live="polite" and role="status" on the message container. Contrast issue: light red background for "firing" state fails AA for body text; either darken background or put text in bold with a visible border. Mina (a11y): Keyboard flow: when adding a channel via keyboard, the focus should jump to the channel chip in the list and an announcement like "Channel added to notification list" should be voiced. For suppression entries, use clear focus outlines and ensure the end-time is announced in humanized format ("ends at 14:30 local time"). Sam: Copy suggestions: change labels from "> X errors" -> "after X errors" and avoid abbreviations in the small inline helper copy. For the preview, prefix messages with "Preview (simulated)" and show the sender name like "Redwood Alerts" so it's clear it's not a real send. Dena: Mobile constraints: the compact layout pushes controls off the row on narrow screens. Proposal: collapse advanced options with a chevron and expose a two-line stacked chip layout for channels. Also quick-snooze grammar is nice — support "snooze 30m", "snooze until 6pm", and natural language like "snooze today" resolving to midnight. Kian: From product: prefer an explicit density toggle rather than multiple implicit states. Add a small "Compact" toggle near the header that switches spacing tokens across the editor. That will keep the visual system consistent. Arjun: Implementation idea: a small live preview component that renders exactly what would be sent to each channel. Dev snippet I used in the prototype: ```
Preview (simulated) — Sent to #alerts, PagerDuty (masked)\n "SLO breached: p95 latency > 300ms for 5 minutes"
``` Nora: Also recommend adding an announcer when suppression is created: "Suppression active for 2 hours, ends at 3:14 PM" so screen reader users don't have to hunt. Sam: UX nit: show persona selector in preview (system / owner / test) and a small badge "TEST" in a contrasting color. For long channel lists show a collapsed count with hover-to-expand and an inline "Edit" affordance. Jules: Plan: Arjun to prototype compact toggle + chip overflow behavior; Nora & Mina to produce an a11y acceptance checklist; Sam to run copy pass and add preview persona wording; Dena to list mobile test cases and snooze grammar examples; Kian will prioritize the toggle in the roadmap. I'll schedule a 20m sync Thursday 9:30am PT to walk the prototype. Arjun: I'll push a prototype branch and post link in this thread when ready. Mina (a11y): I'll start a short a11y checklist doc and link it here once drafted. Dena: Mobile testcases will be in the ticket — will include device screenshots and interaction notes. Sam: Copy pass by EOD Tuesday. Jules: Marking this as in-design. If anyone spots a blocker before Thursday sync, call it out here. :loudspeaker:
